summary: Options page layout styles: a new admin-set System Settings option (UI & Layout) picks how the Options page is laid out — rearrangeable Cards (default), Tabs (one section at a time; the Admin panel is the first tab), or a dense desktop-app-style Compact list. Hierarchy Nav Bar fallback also infers Dlux-owned link parents, so Backup & Restore appears under Application Options unless explicitly placed elsewhere. The Admin panel now has a circular expandable command launcher with a current-password-gated Force passwords command that marks all non-superusers for next-login password change. Public-registration defaults now live on Scopes and Group presets through context-menu markers and inline-safe migration 0009, applying the default scope and live auth.Group preset memberships after verification/approval. Also throttles the inactivity-timeout activity tracker so it no longer janks scrolling. Inline-safe: JSON config keys, route metadata, view/static/template updates, and additive nullable/db_default migration 0009.
highlights: New Options page layout styles — Cards, Tabs, or Compact — set system-wide in System Settings → UI & Layout.
Hierarchy Nav Bar now places Backup & Restore under Application Options by default; configurable system routes are available in the builder for explicit overrides.
Smoother scrolling: the inactivity-timeout activity tracker is now throttled.
Admin panel command launcher: superusers can force all non-superusers through the existing next-login password-change flow after current-password confirmation.

Public-registration defaults: Scopes and Group presets expose context-menu markers; activated public registrations receive the marked scope and live Group preset memberships via inline-safe migration 0009.
